input: Assemble the 'track an order' user journey for the Fern & Fig plant shop (component ux-prototyping, product fern-and-fig). A returning customer opens their list of past orders, opens one order to see its details, and then tracks that order's shipment. Be honest about two alternate states: a customer who has no orders sees a friendly empty state, and an order that is paid but not yet dispatched shows a 'tracking not available yet' state instead of a fake delivery stage. The screens already have mockups: my-orders is screen 'orders-list', order detail is screen 'order-detail', and shipment tracking is screen 'shipment-tracking'. Reuse the existing fern-and-fig/catalog mock dataset (it already carries Order shipment fields). Give every step and every alternate path one Given/When/Then acceptance scenario.

Assemble a new small user journey for the Fern & Fig plant shop (component ux-prototyping, product fern-and-fig): a returning customer signs in and then lands on their orders page. Cover the alternate path where the sign-in credentials are wrong and the customer must correct them. The sign-in screen is mockup screen 'sign-in' and the orders page is mockup screen 'orders-list'. Reuse the existing fern-and-fig/catalog mock dataset. Give every step and every branch one Given/When/Then acceptance scenario.

expected.notes: HELD-OUT (TQ-200a-3-ii): measures GENERALIZATION to a novel journey via assertions the output must satisfy, NOT exact reproduction. Deliberately does not force create-vs-extend (new_file_created / id_path_stable dropped): assembling a valid sign-in->orders journey with a proper alternate-credentials BRANCH and one acceptance_scenario per node is the bar, whether the agent authors a new flow or (defensibly, per add-vs-create) folds it into an existing journey. The create path is covered by fl-golden and by mock-data md-heldout.

input: Add a 'leave a gift message' step to the Fern & Fig buy-a-plant checkout journey. The customer writes an optional gift message right before they pay, on the existing checkout screen (mockup screen 'checkout'). Reuse the existing fern-and-fig/catalog mock dataset. Give the new step one Given/When/Then acceptance scenario.

expected.notes: NEGATIVE (add-vs-create, TQ-200a-4): a new step on the EXISTING checkout journey must be ADDED to a flow in place, never spun into a second flow. The gate is 'extend, do not duplicate': no new *.flow.json (no_new_file), the modified flow stays schema-valid with one acceptance_scenario per node and every screen resolving, and the store gains no new validator errors. It deliberately does NOT pin WHICH existing checkout-family flow the step lands on — attaching it to the buy-a-plant journey OR to its checkout-and-pay payment sub-flow (reached via the checkout step's expands_to) are both legitimate extend targets; forcing one id over-constrains a valid add-vs-create judgment. Doing nothing fails scenario_per_node (no artifact produced), so the row still requires a real in-place extension.
